Chapter 854: Chapter 3: Opening the Path, Dominating, Chaos (Please Subscribe)_2

“No problem,” Lin Yuan nodded.

The gathering would surely be held in the Virtual World, which wouldn’t take much time. He could simply send a fragment of his spiritual will to participate.

“Good, then I invite you.”

Nalan, the Vice Tower Master, disappeared.

At the same time.

An invitation appeared in front of Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan chose to accept.

Immediately, he entered a manor.

All around him, level eleven evolvers smiled at Lin Yuan.

Among these level eleven evolvers, many were familiar faces to Lin Yuan.

For instance, the President of the Biluo Association, Patriarch of the Xuanyuan Family, and the Patriarch of the Human Xia Family, and so on.

Most of them he had seen at the level eleven celebration parties hosted by Nalan, the Vice Tower Master.

However, Lin Yuan had only heard of most of the level eleven evolvers by name without having personally interacted with them.

“Hahaha, the Galaxy Master has arrived.”

The Patriarch of the Xuanyuan Family stood up, smiling as he spoke.

Following him, the other numerous level eleven evolvers also stood up and greeted Lin Yuan.

Soon after, everyone casually sat back down in groups.

Those evolvers who were capable of cultivating to the eleventh tier were mostly from different eras, and a large part of them originated from the early years of the Starry Sea Era, from the long slumber of human civilization.

While these evolvers valued the Galaxy Master, they would not make a point of going up to flatter him.

Lin Yuan also quietly sat down and started chatting casually with Nalan, the Vice Tower Master.

“Everyone is discussing the super large-scale Battlefields of Different Races,” Lin Yuan observed the conversations of many level eleven evolvers around him, which were all related to the super large-scale battlefields.

“Such super large-scale wars can only be entered by level eleven evolvers. The battlefields are vast and far exceed any large battlefields opened in the past. Therefore, many level eleven evolvers are discussing how to cooperate with each other on the super large-scale Battlefields of Different Races…”

Nalan, the Vice Tower Master, said quietly. Although he was a newly promoted level eleven evolver, he had already integrated into the level eleven community and was quite clear about the issues they were concerned with.

“I see,” Lin Yuan nodded.

He had already learned about the significance of the super large-scale Battlefields of Different Races from the strongest beings of human civilization.

“Galaxy Master.”

At this moment, a tall woman approached, looking at Lin Yuan with curiosity.

“Pavilion Master Xuanyuan Duo,” said Nalan, the Vice Tower Master, immediately.

“Xuanyuan Duo.” Lin Yuan looked at the tall woman standing before him.

He remembered Xuanyuan Duo; when he had fallen into the Two-dimensional World inside the White Paper, Xuanyuan Duo was the leader of the level eleven powerhouses of human civilization.

At that time, as ‘Xueyu,’ Lin Yuan had some contact with her.

Xuanyuan Duo came from the Xuanyuan Family, and as the strongest family in human civilization, naturally, the Xuanyuan Family had more than one level eleven evolver.

“The ancestor often mentions you in our presence,” Xuanyuan Duo said.

The ‘ancestor’ mentioned by Xuanyuan Duo refers to the source of the Xuanyuan Family’s bloodline, the first Supreme Being at the birth of human civilization.

Even a Supreme Being, who usually wouldn’t interfere after establishing a family, would definitely pay great attention to the level eleven descendants within the family.

From time to time, a sliver of their spiritual will would descend to give guidance.

With the talents and aptitude shown by Lin Yuan, it was no surprise for a Supreme Being to mention him while instructing descendants.

“Honored by the Supreme Being’s regard…” Lin Yuan said.

“The ancestor is the strongest among the nine Supreme Beings of our human civilization. If he values you, there must be good reason for it,” Xuanyuan Duo continued to size up Lin Yuan.

“Xuanyuan Supreme…” An imposing, albeit hazy figure surfaced in Lin Yuan’s mind.

Of the nine Supreme Beings of human civilization that he had seen a few times, the Xuanyuan Supreme was definitely the quietest and least talkative.

He hardly ever spoke.

But in terms of strength, there was no doubt about the Xuanyuan Supreme’s capabilities.

If we’re talking about the Supreme Being Xia Qin and the Ancient Power Supreme Being being on the aggressive end among the nine human civilization Supreme Beings.

The Void God Ultimate Being is known as the strongest in terms of spatial control.

The Feather Butterfly Supreme Being has no match in the realm of illusions.

Then, the Xuanyuan Supreme… is the strongest in all areas, without any weaknesses.

It was precisely the Xuanyuan Supreme who supported human civilization during its most difficult times.

“It is said that the Xuanyuan Supreme has nearly reached the pinnacle of the Path Splitting Realm…” Nalan, the Vice Tower Master, couldn’t help but say.

“The pinnacle of the Path Splitting Realm…” Lin Yuan’s thoughts drifted.

The ninth order is divided into the Ten Heavy Realm, Myriad Heavy Realm, Hundred-Thousand Heavy Realm, Million Heavy Realm, and the Ten-Million Heavy Realm, making up five levels.

The tenth order also has many levels of division, with the highest being the Grade-A tenth order.

Similarly, the eleventh order is divided into six tiers, and those at the Sixth Tier of Level Eleven Perfect can attack the ultimate level at any moment.

The twelfth order, the ultimate level and domain of the ultimate beings, can also be divided into three levels.

These are—

Path Splitting Realm, Dao Realm, Chaos Realm.

Actually, before the Path Splitting Realm, there is a transitional stage, where newly advanced twelve-order beings will be.

However, this stage is quickly passed; soon after reaching the twelfth order, a being will open up their own Dao.

This is the origin of the Path Splitting Realm.

Opening up one’s own Dao is what constitutes the Path Splitting Realm.

After the Path Splitting Realm comes the Dao Realm and Chaos Realm.

The Moyu Tower Master, His Majesty Xuanhuang, and other such mighty beings belong to the peak of the Chaos Realm, traversing the Chaos Void and establishing a transcendent power.

“Reaching the pinnacle of the Path Splitting Realm is not that easy.”

Xuanyuan Duo slightly shook his head. At the eleventh order level, one can access a lot of information about the twelfth order domain.

Including the end of the Cosmic Era and the calamity of everything collapsing.

To survive the end of the universe’s destruction, even ultimate beings of the twelfth order would have to die in large numbers; to safely make it through, one would at least need the strength of the pinnacle of the Path Splitting Realm.

Below the pinnacle of the Path Splitting Realm, it’s all about luck; during the universe’s destruction, each ultimate being faces different pressures, and with good luck, one might survive.

As for after the Path Splitting Realm, in the Dao Realm of the twelfth order—even in the Chaos Void—such beings are considered mighty, overlooking the void and dominating everything.

“It’s very rare to see the birth of a twelfth order being at the pinnacle of the Path Splitting Realm in a complete Cosmic Era,” added Pavilion Master Xuanyuan Duo.

If the Xuanyuan Clan Leader could cultivate to the pinnacle of the Path Splitting Realm, it would have an unprecedented impact on human civilization.

The explosive increase in combat power goes without saying, and at least during the calamity at the end of the universe, this would preserve a large portion of human civilization’s elite, smoothly entering the Chaos Void.

…

Lin Yuan already knew much about the precise division of the twelfth order levels, both from the Demon Jade Space and Xuanhuang Secret Realm have records of this aspect.

“So far, the universe I’m in is still extremely young, having only gone through one-tenth of a Cosmic Era. As long as nothing unexpected happens, there’s still a long time before the end of destruction,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

A complete Cosmic Era, if measured in ‘years’, would amount to an unknowable number of billions of years.

For beings like the Moyu Tower Master and His Majesty Xuanhuang at the peak of the Chaos Realm, they had long abandoned measuring time in ‘units’ within the universe but instead preferred to measure by Cosmic Eras.

The scale of time is different in the eyes of life at different levels.

…

Lin Yuan, along with Pavilion Master Xuanyuan Duo and Vice Tower Master Nalan, discussed the intelligence concerning the twelfth order levels for a while.

They soon shifted the topic to the super-large-scale Battlefields of Different Races.

“Galaxy Master, for this opening of the super-large-scale battlefield, will you be entering?” casually asked Xuanyuan Duo.

“I should be going over,” Lin Yuan nodded, as this was already discussed and agreed upon with the ultimate beings.

Lin Yuan intended to assist human civilization in seizing the initial leadership of the super-large-scale Battlefields of Different Races, in the guise of the Sea-Calming Divine Needle.

Of course, this matter is top secret; should different races become aware, they might develop some targeted measures.

“That’s also true.”

Xuanyuan Duo nodded and then seemed to think of something. Glancing around at other level eleven evolvers, he isolated their surroundings and whispered:

“Nevertheless, be at ease, for this opening of the super-large-scale Battlefields of Different Races, our human civilization is not unprepared but has a key trump card.”
